none: PAS NLM-287332: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Keelby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Probably Copy Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361. The obverse is restruck over a Gloria Exercitus reverse of 330-340, though the underlying figurative scene is not entirely clear: there may be a quadruped moving left where standards should be! The reverse incorporates lettering perhaps derived from the earlier obverse, in particular the letters [--]CONSTA[--]N[--]. Opposed cut-outs reduce the flan to a figure-of-eight shape recalling that of a Persian shield. Obverse description: Possibly bust right, with underlying features as noted above: a soldier holding spear with lunate ferrule, facing left, is the clearest element of these.…
